 ∀ (vn wn zn : ℕ → KdVPlan.Path) (f g h df dg dh : KdVPlan.Path),
 KdVPlan.XConvergence a b vn f df → KdVPlan.XConvergence a b wn g dg → KdVPlan.XConvergence a b zn h dh →
 (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (vn n t) ∧ KdVPlan.ZeroMean (wn n t) ∧ KdVPlan.ZeroMean (zn n t)) →
 KdVPlan.SeqConv 0 (fun n : ℕ => KdVPlan.tri a b (vn n) (wn n) (zn n)) (KdVPlan.tri a b f g h)
proof:
intro a b ha hab hba vn wn zn f g h df dg dh hf hg hh _
obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := @yui_aux_0057 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013
have hb := hbound a b ha hab hba
let ef : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (fun t => vn n t-f t) (fun t => KdVPlan.dt (vn n) t-df t)
let eg : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (fun t => wn n t-g t) (fun t => KdVPlan.dt (wn n) t-dg t)
let eh : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (fun t => zn n t-h t) (fun t => KdVPlan.dt (zn n) t-dh t)
let xf := KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df
let xg := KdVPlan.Xnorm a b g dg
let xh := KdVPlan.Xnorm a b h dh
have ef0 : Tendsto ef atTop (nhds 0) := @yui_aux_0059 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b vn f df hf
have eg0 : Tendsto eg atTop (nhds 0) := @yui_aux_0059 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b wn g dg hg
have eh0 : Tendsto eh atTop (nhds 0) := @yui_aux_0059 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b zn h dh hh
have hfm : ∀ n, KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b (vn n) (KdVPlan.dt (vn n)) :=
 fun n => @yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b (vn n) hab (hf.2.1 n).1
have hgm : ∀ n, KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b (wn n) (KdVPlan.dt (wn n)) :=
 fun n => @yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b (wn n) hab (hg.2.1 n).1
have hhm : ∀ n, KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b (zn n) (KdVPlan.dt (zn n)) :=
 fun n => @yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b (zn n) hab (hh.2.1 n).1
have hxb₁ : ∀ n, KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (wn n) (KdVPlan.dt (wn n)) ≤ eg n+xg :=
 fun n => @yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b g (wn n) dg (KdVPlan.dt (wn n)) hg.1 (hg.2.1 n).2
have hxb₂ : ∀ n, KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (zn n) (KdVPlan.dt (zn n)) ≤ eh n+xh :=
 fun n => @yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b h (zn n) dh (KdVPlan.dt (zn n)) hh.1 (hh.2.1 n).2
have hdiff : ∀ n, KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.tri a b (vn n) (wn n) (zn n)-KdVPlan.tri a b f g h)
 (C*ef n*(eg n+xg)*(eh n+xh)+C*xf*eg n*(eh n+xh)+C*xf*xg*eh n) := by
 intro n
 let A₁ := KdVPlan.tri a b (fun t => vn n t-f t) (wn n) (zn n)
 let A₂ := KdVPlan.tri a b f (fun t => wn n t-g t) (zn n)
 let A₃ := KdVPlan.tri a b f g (fun t => zn n t-h t)
 have b₁ := hb _ _ _ _ _ _ (hf.2.1 n).2 (hgm n) (hhm n)
 have b₂ := hb _ _ _ _ _ _ hf.1 (hg.2.1 n).2 (hhm n)
 have b₃ := hb _ _ _ _ _ _ hf.1 hg.1 (hh.2.1 n).2
 have he₁ := (@yui_aux_0043 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b (vn n) f (wn n) g (zn n) h hab (hfm n).2.1 hf.1.2.1 (hgm n).2.1 hg.1.2.1 (hhm n).2.1 hh.1.2.1).1
 have he₂ := (@yui_aux_0043 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b f f (wn n) g (zn n) h hab hf.1.2.1 hf.1.2.1 (hgm n).2.1 hg.1.2.1 (hhm n).2.1 hh.1.2.1).2.1
 have he₃ := (@yui_aux_0043 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b f f g g (zn n) h hab hf.1.2.1 hf.1.2.1 hg.1.2.1 hg.1.2.1 (hhm n).2.1 hh.1.2.1).2.2
 have he : KdVPlan.tri a b (vn n) (wn n) (zn n)-KdVPlan.tri a b f g h = (A₁+A₂)+A₃ := by
  dsimp only [A₁, A₂, A₃]
  rw [he₁, he₂, he₃]
  abel
 rw [he]
 have ha := @yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 0 A₁ A₂ b₁.1 b₂.1
 have ha' := @yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 0 (A₁+A₂) A₃ ha.1 b₃.1
 refine ⟨ha'.1, ha'.2.trans ?_⟩
 apply (add_le_add (ha.2.trans (add_le_add b₁.2 b₂.2)) b₃.2).trans
 have hef : 0 ≤ ef n := @yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b _ _
 have heg : 0 ≤ eg n := @yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b _ _
 have heh : 0 ≤ eh n := @yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b _ _
 have hxf : 0 ≤ xf := @yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b f df
 have hxg : 0 ≤ xg := @yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b g dg
 have hxh : 0 ≤ xh := @yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b h dh
 have hxgn := @yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b (wn n) (KdVPlan.dt (wn n))
 have hxhn := @yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b (zn n) (KdVPlan.dt (zn n))
 change C*ef n*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (wn n) (KdVPlan.dt (wn n))*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (zn n) (KdVPlan.dt (zn n))+
 C*xf*eg n*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (zn n) (KdVPlan.dt (zn n))+C*xf*xg*eh n ≤ _
 gcongr
have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.tri a b (vn n) (wn n) (zn n)-KdVPlan.tri a b f g h)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
 apply squeeze_zero (fun n => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (fun n => (hdiff n).2)
 have h₁ := ((ef0.const_mul C).mul (eg0.add_const xg)).mul (eh0.add_const xh)
 have h₂ := (eg0.const_mul (C*xf)).mul (eh0.add_const xh)
 have h₃ := eh0.const_mul (C*xf*xg)
 simpa only [mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, add_zero] using (h₁.add h₂).add h₃
refine ⟨(hb f g h df dg dh hf.1 hg.1 hh.1).1, ?_⟩
intro ε hε
obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hlim ε hε
refine ⟨m, fun n hnm => ⟨(hdiff n).1, ?_⟩⟩
have hp : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.tri a b (vn n) (wn n) (zn n)-KdVPlan.tri a b f g h) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
exact le_of_lt (by simpa only [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hp] using hm n hnm)
